prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: the courtyards and exposed subterranean laboratories of a royal magic academy. Scene/backdrop: arcane stone campus with crystal clusters, brass arcane mechanisms, elevated stone ledges, colonnades, and glimpses into luminous underground chambers. Subject: alternating open courtyards and constricted passages formed by long walls and columns; a large restrained arcane astrolabe as landmark. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: cool violet-blue magical ambient light balanced with readable warm stone daylight. Color palette: desaturated stone, indigo, teal crystal glow, restrained brass. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space. Avoid: sci-fi technology, excessive particle clutter, illegible neon, floating text or runes.
